name: Cafe im Hof
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Café im Hof in Innsbruck** – a charming café nestled in the heart of the historic **Innsbruck** old town. Here, you can savor traditional Austrian coffee and indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy, caramelized pancake torn into pieces and served with apricot jam. Our cozy atmosphere invites you to relax with a warm cup of **Melange** or a glass of **Apfelstrudel** wine while enjoying the picturesque views of the **Nordkette** mountains. Whether you're planning a day trip to the **Zillertal** or exploring the **Goldenes Dachl**, Café im Hof is the perfect place to start your adventure in **Tirol**. Come and experience authentic **Tiroler** hospitality in one of the most beautiful regions of Austria!
